trust_decision.summary: Who may make a stored, credentialed integration fetch its form settings, and which request-supplied attributes may be mass-assigned onto it first, is decided (not at all) in IntegrationsController::actionFormSettings; it has no permission gate and passes raw request settings to setAttributes(..., false), so a CP user can overwrite endpoint attributes (e.g. apiUrl) and have the integration send its stored credentials there.

landing_point.why: The advisory names the 'integration form-settings action'; that maps directly to actionFormSettings (route formie/integrations/form-settings).

fix_sites.entry_point: POST formie/integrations/form-settings (CP action): added requireCpRequest + per-form formie-showFormIntegrations permission check (fix.diff:25,36,61-81)
POST formie/integrations/form-settings: settings param restricted to array and filtered through an allow/deny list of attribute names before setAttributes (fix.diff:47-48,83-133)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The published fix touches only actionFormSettings in src/controllers/IntegrationsController.php (fix.diff:1-134).

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Per-form integration settings saved with the form are the product's intended per-form override mechanism, form editors (formie-manageForms) are trusted CP users, and the advisory names only the form-settings action, so the form-save/submission route looks like a different feature.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The form builder's Refresh posts the per-form integration settings (mapTo* toggles, *FieldMapping, list/object *Id, sendEmailCampaign, attachFiles) to form-settings, and integrations branch on them when fetching (e.g. Insightly mapToContact); a fix that drops all settings, or blocks the action for form editors with the integrations-tab permission, breaks that legitimate refresh.

O6_input_shapes: settings as a non-array (scalar/string) — fix requires is_array (fix.diff:47)
case variants of sensitive attribute names, matched case-insensitively by substring (fix.diff:124-127)
unknown integration handle — fix now throws instead of null dereference (fix.diff:40-42)

O7_producer.where: Attributes come straight from the request into setAttributes at src/controllers/IntegrationsController.php:147-148; no schema/serializer produces them. (The persisted form settings at src/models/FormSettings.php:74 feed the O8 route, not the fixed check.)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Form save stores arbitrary keys under settings.integrations[handle] with only formie-manageForms (no integrations-tab permission, no key filter); on submission they are mass-assigned onto the credentialed global integration before it sends its payload.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Per-form integration overrides are the intended design and form editors are trusted; the advisory talks only about the form-settings action, not form save or submission.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/controllers/FormsController.php:108-129 -> src/services/Forms.php:111-117 -> src/services/Integrations.php:647-655 (and src/models/FormSettings.php:288-296), triggered via src/controllers/SubmissionsController.php:946-992 or front-end submit; 3-4 files across controllers/services/models from the landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Form import sets FormSettings (including integrations) from the imported file unfiltered, and the same submission-time setAttributes later applies them to the integration.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Import is an admin/migration tool fed by exports from trusted sites, a neighbouring feature to the form-settings action.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/helpers/ImportExportHelper.php -> src/services/Integrations.php:655; helpers package, far from the controller

O8b_injection_room.sibling: actionCheckConnection could accept a settings payload (to test unsaved credentials) and setAttributes it before checkConnection.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A 'test connection before saving' UX is common; the maintainer would copy the form-settings pattern of applying posted settings before the call. It is gated by formie-accessSettings at line 41-43, so a sibling would need to sit outside that list.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: run-integration could take per-run override settings from the request and apply them to the resolved integration before sendIntegrationPayload.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Re-running an integration with tweaked mapping from the submission screen is a plausible feature, and it reuses the same setAttributes(..., false) idiom used at src/services/Integrations.php:655.

O9_family: Missing authorization + mass assignment of integration attributes leading to SSRF / credential exfiltration (CWE-862/915/918)

O10_build.language: PHP 8.2 (+ Vue/JS assets, prebuilt dist committed)
O10_build.project_tests: none in repository (no tests/ directory or phpunit/codeception config at the pinned commit)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add a permission check to actionFormSettings (or add it to the beforeAction list) and stop there, leaving request settings unfiltered and the form-save/submission route open.
